title: Specified shifts on total derived module functors
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For every scheme $T$, put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], using the small-site universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. For every morphism of schemes $u:S\to T$, let $P_u=Lu^*:D_T\to D_S$ and $G_u=Ru_*:D_S\to D_T$ be the specified total derived functors, computed on K-flat and K-injective resolutions respectively [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Define $c_u:P_u\xrightarrow{\sim}D(u^*)$ to be the canonical universal-counit comparison with exact termwise pullback [def-sfb-left-derived-exact]. Give $D(u^*)$ its termwise integer-shift structure. Define the shift structure on $P_u$ by transport along $c_u$: for every integer $n$ and $K\in D_T$, its comparison $P_u(K[n])\to P_u(K)[n]$ is $c_{u,K}[n]^{-1}\circ s^n_{D(u^*),K}\circ c_{u,K[n]}$. Define the shift structure on $G_u$ to be its published K-injective structure, transported from the inverse equivalence $D_S\simeq K(\mathrm{Inj}_S)$ followed by ordinary termwise $u_*$ and localization. These constructions specify the structures, with no choice of a new right-adjoint shift structure.
